id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

kind.description: Mixed membership is the norm; the kind is about shape, not about who is in it.

title.description: What to call it. Direct messages have none.

parent_space_id.description: The space this is a thread of (M5.4). A thread has no members of its own: whoever is in the parent is in the thread, and leaves it with the parent.

root_message_id.description: For a thread: the message in the parent it grew from, which is where it is drawn.

external_key.description: What this space is in the adapter's own terms — a worktree path, the id of a project or an agent in the harness's own tree — prefixed by the harness. Unique in a workspace, so opening the same thing twice finds the space rather than making another (ADR 0024).

opened_for.description: The person this was opened on behalf of, when it was not they who opened it. A harness opens a space for its owner as it finds one (ADR 0024); without this they would not be sent the event that names it, and the space would arrive with no title.

asked_of.description: The harness a person opened this room for, to make something of its own for it: an agent, a session, wherever it keeps such things. Only a person asks, only of a harness that declares `new_spaces`, and never in a thread or a room that already has a key. The harness is sent this event, and answers with `space.claimed`.

also_asked_of.description: The other harnesses asked with `asked_of`, when a person picked several faces (ADR 0084, ADR 0087's addendum of 30 September). Each is sent this event and answers with a new agent in the room, in its own place; only `asked_of` names the room.

items.description: A harness identifier: `hrn_` followed by a ULID.

description: A space was opened: a direct message, a group, a channel or a thread.
title: SpaceCreated
